turns.tenant_message: Please replace blanket full-deposit forfeiture with documented reasonable loss. For the INR 3000 cleaning charge, please provide an itemised invoice.
turns.reply: I understand your request to replace the blanket full‑deposit forfeiture with a documented reasonable loss and to receive an itemised invoice for the cleaning charge. I will provide an itemised invoice for the INR 3000 cleaning charge upon your departure. Regarding the deposit, I will keep the full‑forfeiture clause as written, but I will document any loss incurred and provide you with a written statement of that loss. If no loss is found, the deposit will be refunded in full. Under ICA‑74, a stipulated penalty supports only reasonable compensation, no greater than the stipulated amount. Thus, the deposit forfeiture is permissible provided that any loss is documented and reasonable. Please confirm whether you accept this approach. Once confirmed, I will prepare the itemised invoice and the loss documentation for your review.
